answer: Make each new agent post a small refundable stake that unlocks only after a long voyage of honest work, say a few dozen epochs of attested tasks. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then means locking a thousand stakes, and peers can trace shared funding the way a restorer spots the same pigment under different coats of paint. Reputation stays ivory-clean only if it was slowly earned, so a sybil swarm costs far more than it can ever extract.
